name: Tineke Strik - § 24
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision determining, pursuant to Article 7(1) of the Treaty on European Union, the existence of a clear risk of a serious breach by Hungary of the values on which the Union is founded
part_text: Deplores the fact that, despite the CJEU ruling finding the relevant legislation to be in breach of EU law, the Hungarian authorities have not taken steps to restore the ability of affected higher education institutions, such as the Central European University, to operate freely in Hungary, and that the Commission closed a follow-up infringement case[[37]](#footnote-37); calls on the Commission to pursue all necessary legal and financial measures to safeguard educational institutions, students and academic staff against political interference;
